I brought my dog with an open wound here and this is the WORST PLACE YOU CAN HAVE YOUR DOG CHECKED ! One of our colleagues recommended this place but I truly do regret coming. If your dog is sick don’t take him it will be a waste of your time and money. It may be economical but you sure do pay what you get for. As we arrived we waited 25 minutes to be seen, The lady who works there, the “primary” vet was very rude and you could tell she had no customer service skills what so ever. The place is filthy, unorganized, and unprofessional. After she got done seeing the dog in front of us, a lady who happened to be her neighbor cut the entire line and she was seen BEFORE US which is completely fine but in the state our dog came in she should have waited in line to be seen. After it was our time to be seen the primary vet did not even bother to WASH HER HANDS to review an OPEN WOUND. She decided to take a phone call and when I brought it to her attention that the dog couldn’t even stand up because of how bad his wound was SHE KICKD US OUT AND LET US KNOW THEY WOULD NOT HELP US.  This is truly not a place where you would like your pets to be looked at as they feel entitled to kick you out. As a business owner this is beyond me to treat a potential client like this as the CUSTOMER IS ALWAYS RIGHT and to KICK THEM OUT IN A TIME OF DESPERATION AN HELP. Not only will I put a complaint  with the California Veterinary Medical Board but I will also be taking it to small claims court due to negligence.

I am extremely amazed by this place especially my first time coming here! A lot of my neighbors who have dogs recommended me coming here since my dog was infested with fleas, my neighbors told me they would help me here and attend my dog. When I called to make sure they can attend my dog they answered the phone right away and told me that I can come in, once I came in the pet shop they asked what I needed help with and assisted my dog right away. The women that works there gave me a chewable medication for my dog for fleas (lasts about month) and a bar soap for fleas to shower my dog, she explained to me how to shower her and to wash my dogs bed and I won’t be seeing fleas after giving her the medication anymore! And just like she said she was right, the next day my dog had no fleas and then after a week she had no fleas, I’m so happy I came here for my dog, since she was suffering from fleas, and scratching every second, she finally feels relieved and flea free! In a few weeks I’ll be coming again to pick up her medication for fleas for the next month! Thank you Jurado’s pet shop!
